BSB/1CO/11.1: You are to imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.
BSB/1CO/11.2: Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.
BSB/1CO/11.3: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
BSB/1CO/11.4: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
BSB/1CO/11.5: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.
BSB/1CO/11.6: If a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off. And if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.
BSB/1CO/11.7: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
BSB/1CO/11.8: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man.
BSB/1CO/11.9: Neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.
BSB/1CO/11.10: For this reason a woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.
BSB/1CO/11.11: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.
BSB/1CO/11.12: For just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.
BSB/1CO/11.13: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
BSB/1CO/11.14: Doesn’t nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
BSB/1CO/11.15: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
BSB/1CO/11.16: If anyone is inclined to dispute this, we have no other practice, nor do the churches of God.
BSB/1CO/11.17: In the following instructions I have no praise to offer, because your gatherings do more harm than good.
BSB/1CO/11.18: First of all, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and in part I believe it.
BSB/1CO/11.19: And indeed, there must be differences among you to show which of you are approved.
BSB/1CO/11.20: Now then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat.
BSB/1CO/11.21: For as you eat, each of you goes ahead without sharing his meal. While one remains hungry, another gets drunk.
BSB/1CO/11.22: Don’t you have your own homes in which to eat and drink? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? What can I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? No, I will not!
BSB/1CO/11.23: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night He was betrayed, took bread,
BSB/1CO/11.24: and when He had given thanks, He broke it and said,“This is My body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
BSB/1CO/11.25: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying,“This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”
BSB/1CO/11.26: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.
BSB/1CO/11.27: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
BSB/1CO/11.28: Each one must examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.
BSB/1CO/11.29: For anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body eats and drinks judgment on himself.
BSB/1CO/11.30: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.
BSB/1CO/11.31: Now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.
BSB/1CO/11.32: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
BSB/1CO/11.33: So, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
BSB/1CO/11.34: If anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that when you come together it will not result in judgment. And when I come, I will give instructions about the remaining matters.

BSB/ISA/53.1:
Who has believed our message?
And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?
BSB/ISA/53.2:
He grew up before Him like a tender shoot,
and like a root out of dry ground.
He had no stately form or majesty to attract us,
no beauty that we should desire Him.
BSB/ISA/53.3:
He was despised and rejected by men,
a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief.
Like one from whom men hide their faces,
He was despised, and we esteemed Him not.
BSB/ISA/53.4:
Surely He took up our infirmities
and carried our sorrows;
yet we considered Him stricken,
struck down by God, and afflicted.
BSB/ISA/53.5:
But He was pierced for our transgressions,
He was crushed for our iniquities;
the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him,
and by His stripes we are healed.
BSB/ISA/53.6:
We all like sheep have gone astray,
each one has turned to his own way;
and the LORD has laid upon Him
the iniquity of us all.
BSB/ISA/53.7:
He was oppressed and afflicted,
yet He did not open His mouth.
He was led like a lamb to the slaughter,
and as a sheep before her shearers is silent,
so He did not open His mouth.
BSB/ISA/53.8:
By oppression and judgment He was taken away,
and who can recount His descendants?
For He was cut off from the land of the living;
He was stricken for the transgression of My people.
BSB/ISA/53.9:
He was assigned a grave with the wicked,
and with a rich man in His death,
although He had done no violence,
nor was any deceit in His mouth.
BSB/ISA/53.10:
Yet it was the LORD’s will to crush Him
and to cause Him to suffer;
and when His soul is made a guilt offering,
He will see His offspring, He will prolong His days,
and the good pleasure of the LORD will prosper in His hand.
BSB/ISA/53.11:
After the anguish of His soul,
He will see the light of life
and be satisfied.
By His knowledge My righteous Servant will justify many,
and He will bear their iniquities.
BSB/ISA/53.12:
Therefore I will allot Him a portion with the great,
and He will divide the spoils with the strong,
because He has poured out His life unto death,
and He was numbered with the transgressors.
Yet He bore the sin of many
and made intercession for the transgressors.

BSB/JHN/13.1: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.
BSB/JHN/13.2: The evening meal was underway, and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
BSB/JHN/13.3: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
BSB/JHN/13.4: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.
BSB/JHN/13.5: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.
BSB/JHN/13.6: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”
BSB/JHN/13.7: Jesus replied,“You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
BSB/JHN/13.8:
“Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him.
Jesus answered,“Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”
BSB/JHN/13.9: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”
BSB/JHN/13.10: Jesus told him,“Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
BSB/JHN/13.11: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said,“Not all of you are clean.”
BSB/JHN/13.12: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again and asked,“Do you know what I have done for you?
BSB/JHN/13.13: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.
BSB/JHN/13.14: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
BSB/JHN/13.15: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.
BSB/JHN/13.16: Truly, truly, I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
BSB/JHN/13.17: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
BSB/JHN/13.18: I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’
BSB/JHN/13.19: I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it comes to pass, you will believe that I am He.
BSB/JHN/13.20: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever receives the one I send receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me.”
BSB/JHN/13.21: After Jesus had said this, He became troubled in spirit and testified,“Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
BSB/JHN/13.22: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed as to which of them He meant.
BSB/JHN/13.23: One of His disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was reclining at His side.
BSB/JHN/13.24: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus which one He was talking about.
BSB/JHN/13.25: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”
BSB/JHN/13.26: Jesus answered,“It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.”Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
BSB/JHN/13.27:
And when Judas had taken the morsel, Satan entered into him.
Then Jesus said to Judas,“What you are about to do, do quickly.”
BSB/JHN/13.28: But no one at the table knew why Jesus had said this to him.
BSB/JHN/13.29: Since Judas kept the money bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor.
BSB/JHN/13.30: As soon as he had received the morsel, Judas went out into the night.
BSB/JHN/13.31: When Judas had gone out, Jesus said,“Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
BSB/JHN/13.32: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself — and will glorify Him at once.
BSB/JHN/13.33: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer. You will look for Me, and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’
BSB/JHN/13.34: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
BSB/JHN/13.35: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”
BSB/JHN/13.36:
“Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked.
Jesus answered,“Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”
BSB/JHN/13.37: “Lord,” said Peter, “why can’t I follow You now? I will lay down my life for You.”
BSB/JHN/13.38: “Will you lay down your life for Me?” Jesus replied.“Truly, truly, I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.[’’]

BSB/LUK/13.1: At that time some of those present told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
BSB/LUK/13.2: To this He replied,“Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered this way?
BSB/LUK/13.3: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.
BSB/LUK/13.4: Or those eighteen who were killed when the tower of Siloam collapsed on them: Do you think that they were more sinful than all the others living in Jerusalem?
BSB/LUK/13.5: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.”
BSB/LUK/13.6: Then Jesus told this parable:“A man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard. He went to look for fruit on it but did not find any.
BSB/LUK/13.7: So he said to the keeper of the vineyard, ‘Look, for the past three years I have come to search for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Therefore cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?’
BSB/LUK/13.8: ‘Sir,’ the man replied, ‘leave it alone again this year, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
BSB/LUK/13.9: If it bears fruit next year, fine. But if not, you can cut it down.’”
BSB/LUK/13.10: One Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,
BSB/LUK/13.11: and a woman there had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was hunched over and could not stand up straight.
BSB/LUK/13.12: When Jesus saw her, He called her over and said,“Woman, you are set free from your disability.”
BSB/LUK/13.13: Then He placed His hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and began to glorify God.
BSB/LUK/13.14: But the synagogue leader was indignant that Jesus had healed on the Sabbath. “There are six days for work,” he told the crowd. “So come and be healed on those days and not on the Sabbath.”
BSB/LUK/13.15: “You hypocrites!” the Lord replied.“Does not each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it to water?
BSB/LUK/13.16: Then should not this daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be released from her bondage on the Sabbath day?”
BSB/LUK/13.17: When Jesus said this, all His adversaries were humiliated. And the whole crowd rejoiced at all the glorious things He was doing.
BSB/LUK/13.18: Then Jesus asked,“What is the kingdom of God like? To what can I compare it?
BSB/LUK/13.19: It is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air nested in its branches.”
BSB/LUK/13.20: Again He asked,“To what can I compare the kingdom of God?
BSB/LUK/13.21: It is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
BSB/LUK/13.22: Then Jesus traveled throughout the towns and villages, teaching as He made His way toward Jerusalem.
BSB/LUK/13.23:
“Lord,” someone asked Him, “will only a few people be saved?”
Jesus answered,
BSB/LUK/13.24: “Make every effort to enter through the narrow door. For many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.
BSB/LUK/13.25:
After the master of the house gets up and shuts the door, you will stand outside knocking and saying, ‘Lord, open the door for us.’
But he will reply, ‘I do not know where you are from.’
BSB/LUK/13.26: Then you will say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’
BSB/LUK/13.27: And he will answer, ‘I tell you, I do not know where you are from. Depart from me, all you evildoers.’
BSB/LUK/13.28: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are thrown out.
BSB/LUK/13.29: People will come from east and west and north and south, and will recline at the table in the kingdom of God.
BSB/LUK/13.30: And indeed, some who are last will be first, and some who are first will be last.”
BSB/LUK/13.31: At that very hour, some Pharisees came to Jesus and told Him, “Leave this place and get away, because Herod wants to kill You.”
BSB/LUK/13.32: But Jesus replied,“Go tell that fox, ‘Look, I will keep driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach My goal.’
BSB/LUK/13.33: Nevertheless, I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day, for it is not admissible for a prophet to perish outside of Jerusalem.
BSB/LUK/13.34: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
BSB/LUK/13.35: Look, your house is left to you desolate. And I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’ ”

cmn_cuv/1CO/11.1: 你們該效法我，像我效法基督一樣。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.2: 我稱讚你們，因你們凡事記念我，又堅守我所傳給你們的。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.3: 我願意你們知道，基督是各人的頭；男人是女人的頭；上帝是基督的頭。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.4: 凡男人禱告或是講道 ，若蒙着頭，就羞辱自己的頭。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.5: 凡女人禱告或是講道，若不蒙着頭，就羞辱自己的頭，因為這就如同剃了頭髮一樣。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.6: 女人若不蒙着頭，就該剪了頭髮；女人若以剪髮、剃髮為羞愧，就該蒙着頭。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.7: 男人本不該蒙着頭，因為他是上帝的形像和榮耀；但女人是男人的榮耀。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.8: 起初，男人不是由女人而出，女人乃是由男人而出；
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.9: 並且男人不是為女人造的，女人乃是為男人造的。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.10: 因此，女人為天使的緣故，應當在頭上有服權柄的記號。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.11: 然而照主的安排，女也不是無男，男也不是無女。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.12: 因為女人原是由男人而出，男人也是由女人而出；但萬有都是出乎上帝。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.13: 你們自己審察，女人禱告上帝，不蒙着頭是合宜的嗎？
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.14: 你們的本性不也指示你們，男人若有長頭髮，便是他的羞辱嗎？
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.15: 但女人有長頭髮，乃是她的榮耀，因為這頭髮是給她作蓋頭的。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.16: 若有人想要辯駁，我們卻沒有這樣的規矩，上帝的眾教會也是沒有的。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.17: 我現今吩咐你們的話，不是稱讚你們；因為你們聚會不是受益，乃是招損。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.18: 第一，我聽說，你們聚會的時候彼此分門別類，我也稍微地信這話。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.19: 在你們中間不免有分門結黨的事，好叫那些有經驗的人顯明出來。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.20: 你們聚會的時候，算不得吃主的晚餐；
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.21: 因為吃的時候，各人先吃自己的飯，甚至這個飢餓，那個酒醉。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.22: 你們要吃喝，難道沒有家嗎？還是藐視上帝的教會，叫那沒有的羞愧呢？我向你們可怎麼說呢？可因此稱讚你們嗎？我不稱讚！
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.23: 我當日傳給你們的，原是從主領受的，就是主耶穌被賣的那一夜，拿起餅來，
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.24: 祝謝了，就擘開，說：「這是我的身體，為你們捨 的，你們應當如此行，為的是記念我。」
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.25: 飯後，也照樣拿起杯來，說：「這杯是用我的血所立的新約，你們每逢喝的時候，要如此行，為的是記念我。」
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.26: 你們每逢吃這餅，喝這杯，是表明主的死，直等到他來。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.27: 所以，無論何人，不按理吃主的餅，喝主的杯，就是干犯主的身、主的血了。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.28: 人應當自己省察，然後吃這餅、喝這杯。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.29: 因為人吃喝，若不分辨是主的身體，就是吃喝自己的罪了。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.30: 因此，在你們中間有好些軟弱的與患病的，死 的也不少。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.31: 我們若是先分辨自己，就不至於受審。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.32: 我們受審的時候，乃是被主懲治，免得我們和世人一同定罪。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.33: 所以我弟兄們，你們聚會吃的時候，要彼此等待。
cmn_cuv/1CO/11.34: 若有人飢餓，可以在家裏先吃，免得你們聚會，自己取罪。其餘的事，我來的時候再安排。

cmn_cuv/ISA/53.1:
我們所傳的
有誰信呢？
耶和華的膀臂向誰顯露呢？
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.2:
他在耶和華面前生長如嫩芽，
像根出於乾地。
他無佳形美容；
我們看見他的時候，
也無美貌使我們羨慕他。
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.3:
他被藐視，被人厭棄；
多受痛苦，常經憂患。
他被藐視，
好像被人掩面不看的一樣；
我們也不尊重他。
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.4:
他誠然擔當我們的憂患，
背負我們的痛苦；
我們卻以為他受責罰，
被上帝擊打苦待了。
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.5:
哪知他為我們的過犯受害，
為我們的罪孽壓傷。
因他受的刑罰，我們得平安；
因他受的鞭傷，我們得醫治。
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.6:
我們都如羊走迷；
各人偏行己路；
耶和華使我們眾人的罪孽都歸在他身上。
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.7:
他被欺壓，
在受苦的時候卻不開口
；
他像羊羔被牽到宰殺之地，
又像羊在剪毛的人手下無聲，
他也是這樣不開口。
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.8:
因受欺壓和審判，他被奪去，
至於他同世的人，誰想他受鞭打、
從活人之地被剪除，
是因我百姓的罪過呢？
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.9:
他雖然未行強暴，
口中也沒有詭詐，
人還使他與惡人同埋；
誰知死的時候與財主同葬。
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.10:
耶和華卻定意
將他壓傷，
使他受痛苦。
耶和華以他為贖罪祭
。
他必看見後裔，並且延長年日。
耶和華所喜悅的事必在他手中亨通。
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.11:
他必看見自己勞苦的功效，
便心滿意足。
有許多人因認識我的義僕得稱為義；
並且他要擔當他們的罪孽。
cmn_cuv/ISA/53.12:
所以，我要使他與位大的同分，
與強盛的均分擄物。
因為他將命傾倒，以致於死；
他也被列在罪犯之中。
他卻擔當多人的罪，
又為罪犯代求。

cmn_cuv/JHN/13.1: 逾越節以前，耶穌知道自己離世歸父的時候到了。他既然愛世間屬自己的人，就愛他們到底。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.2: 吃晚飯的時候，魔鬼已將賣耶穌的意思放在西門的兒子加略人猶大心裏。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.3: 耶穌知道父已將萬有交在他手裏，且知道自己是從上帝出來的，又要歸到上帝那裏去，
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.4: 就離席站起來，脫了衣服，拿一條手巾束腰，
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.5: 隨後把水倒在盆裏，就洗門徒的腳，並用自己所束的手巾擦乾。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.6: 挨到西門‧彼得，彼得對他說：「主啊，你洗我的腳嗎？」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.7: 耶穌回答說：「我所做的，你如今不知道，後來必明白。」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.8: 彼得說：「你永不可洗我的腳！」耶穌說：「我若不洗你，你就與我無分了。」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.9: 西門‧彼得說：「主啊，不但我的腳，連手和頭也要洗。」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.10: 耶穌說：「凡洗過澡的人，只要把腳一洗，全身就乾淨了。你們是乾淨的，然而不都是乾淨的。」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.11: 耶穌原知道要賣他的是誰，所以說：「你們不都是乾淨的。」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.12: 耶穌洗完了他們的腳，就穿上衣服，又坐下，對他們說：「我向你們所做的，你們明白嗎？
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.13: 你們稱呼我夫子，稱呼我主，你們說的不錯，我本來是。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.14: 我是你們的主，你們的夫子，尚且洗你們的腳，你們也當彼此洗腳。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.15: 我給你們作了榜樣，叫你們照着我向你們所做的去做。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.16: 我實實在在地告訴你們，僕人不能大於主人，差人也不能大於差他的人。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.17: 你們既知道這事，若是去行就有福了。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.18: 我這話不是指着你們眾人說的，我知道我所揀選的是誰。現在要應驗經上的話，說：『同我吃飯的人用腳踢我。』
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.19: 如今事情還沒有成就，我要先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候可以信我是基督。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.20: 我實實在在地告訴你們，有人接待我所差遣的，就是接待我；接待我，就是接待那差遣我的。」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.21: 耶穌說了這話，心裏憂愁，就明說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們中間有一個人要賣我了。」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.22: 門徒彼此對看，猜不透所說的是誰。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.23: 有一個門徒，是耶穌所愛的，側身挨近耶穌的懷裏。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.24: 西門‧彼得點頭對他說：「你告訴我們，主是指着誰說的。」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.25: 那門徒便就勢靠着耶穌的胸膛，問他說：「主啊，是誰呢？」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.26: 耶穌回答說：「我蘸一點餅給誰，就是誰。」耶穌就蘸了一點餅，遞給加略人西門的兒子猶大。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.27: 他吃了以後，撒但就入了他的心。耶穌便對他說：「你所做的，快做吧！」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.28: 同席的人沒有一個知道是為甚麼對他說這話。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.29: 有人因猶大帶着錢囊，以為耶穌是對他說：「你去買我們過節所應用的東西」，或是叫他拿甚麼賙濟窮人。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.30: 猶大受了那點餅，立刻就出去。那時候是夜間了。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.31: 他既出去，耶穌就說：「如今人子得了榮耀，上帝在人子身上也得了榮耀。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.32: 上帝要因自己榮耀人子，並且要快快地榮耀他。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.33: 小子們，我還有不多的時候與你們同在；後來你們要找我，但我所去的地方你們不能到。這話我曾對猶太人說過，如今也照樣對你們說。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.34: 我賜給你們一條新命令，乃是叫你們彼此相愛；我怎樣愛你們，你們也要怎樣相愛。
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.35: 你們若有彼此相愛的心，眾人因此就認出你們是我的門徒了。」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.36: 西門‧彼得問耶穌說：「主往哪裏去？」耶穌回答說：「我所去的地方，你現在不能跟我去，後來卻要跟我去。」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.37: 彼得說：「主啊，我為甚麼現在不能跟你去？我願意為你捨命！」
cmn_cuv/JHN/13.38: 耶穌說：「你願意為我捨命嗎？我實實在在地告訴你，雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」
